ideas.title: Does it foam? Ep 1: Shampoo and conditioner
ideas.hook: Hold up the shampoo and conditioner. Text: DOES IT FOAM?
steps: Hold the product up to camera
Pour it into the foam cannon
Spray it on a TEST PANEL only, never a customer car
Show the result: thick, runny or nothing
Give it a score out of 10 and say: "Comment what we should try next"
Rinse the foam cannon properly after
ideas.caption: Does it foam? Ep 1: shampoo and conditioner😭
